svg.text: One flow as a hexagon: the domain service, its ports (traits, dashed yellow), the adapters behind them, and the data plane they start
TransferService<S, A, F, D, C, E>
Provider side of the transfer process: request, start,
suspend, complete, terminate; checks the agreement and its
New ids and the current time
Start and stop the data flow;
Speaks Data Plane Signaling to the
data plane; a repeated signal counts
Built-in HTTP pull data plane: a
random bearer token per flow; only
its SHA-256 hash is kept, with an
authorize(id, token), then fetch the source
C4 model, level 4. Solid arrows: uses. Dashed arrows: implements. Without the data-plane feature, NoDataFlows (transfer.rs) stands behind DataFlows and every transfer is refused.
